body:
## Context

`_fetch_one` already dispatches `isbn:`-prefixed identifiers to the Libgen
fetcher, and batch mode accepts an `isbn:` prefix in the DOI column. But the
single-item path (`fetch.py --doi`) ran `validate_doi`, which rejects an ISBN —
so a single book could only be fetched by invoking `fetch_libgen.py` directly,
bypassing the orchestrator's Zotero dedup and logging.

## Change

- `--isbn` flag on the orchestrator, routed as `isbn:<value>` through the
  existing dispatch (no `validate_doi`).
- Single-item mode now triggers on `--isbn` as well as `--doi`/`--title`.
- README: single-book CLI example.

`--doi` behavior and DOI validation are unchanged. The `isbn:` prefix convention
is reused rather than adding a parallel code path, so batch and single modes
share one dispatcher.

## Tests

- `test_parse_args_supports_isbn` — flag is parsed.
- `test_handle_single_download_routes_isbn_to_libgen` — dispatches to Libgen as
  `isbn:<value>` (monkeypatched).
- Full fast suite: 58 passed, 1 skipped; ruff clean.

Verified end-to-end: `fetch.py --isbn 0000000000000 --source libgen` fails at
Libgen ("not found on Libgen"), confirming the route — not rejected as a bad DOI.

**Ticket:** tickets/0003-add-isbn-single-download-flag-to-fetch-p.erg
